description: Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission Ref: P1330.25 dated 29/01/2026 to allow for the change from first floor front middle window to a front full-height feature glazed window (sited above the main entrance door), replace the approved pitched to flat roofs above each bay window to the front, and side window to the utility room. (Erection of single storey side extension, front porch extension, hip to gable loft conversion with side dormers and solar panels and alterations to fenestration. External alterations including replacement and repair of existing render with new white render and replacement of roof tiles.)
decision_conditions: The amendments to the approved application listed below is considered to be of a minor nature and acceptable in its own right and not require resubmission of a fresh planning application;

1.	To allow for the change from first floor front middle window to a front full-height glazed feature window (sited above the main entrance door), replace the approved the pitched to flat roofs above each bay window to the front, and side window to the utility room.

The applicant is advised that this amendment relates solely to the items detailed above and annotated on drawing labelled of PL01F and not to any other deviation from the approved drawings. Furthermore, this amendment does not in any way alter or remove any previous conditions imposed on the original approved application reference P1330.25.
